name: coding-agent-installer-bundle
description: Declares agent-installer >=0.8.0 for build-time Skill Bundle installation (S1b). 0.8.0 is the minimum release satisfying agent-installer#74 (complete Git artifact provenance with freshly verified installed copies). The exact resolved release is pinned by package-lock.json, so image builds stay reproducible and an upgrade is a lockfile refresh, not a code change. Not part of the running agent.
